meta.title: $250K Giveaway – Lenix Protocol
meta.description: Enter the Lenix Protocol $250,000 Giveaway. Ten winners receive $25,000 in LNX. Learn how to enter, prizes, rules, and FAQs.

Hero.title1: Enter Our Competition for a Chance to
Hero.description: Ten winners each receive $25,000 worth of LNX. Complete tasks, share, and boost your entries. Transparent rules, fair selection, and on-chain distribution.

Prizes.title: Prizes
Prizes.description: A total of $250,000 in LNX will be distributed to 10 winners. Each winner gets $25,000 worth of LNX.

Enter.title: How to Enter
Enter.description: Complete the steps below. More tasks completed = more entries.

1.label: Step 1
1.title: Connect your wallet
1.description: Use the Connect Wallet button in the header. Ensure you control the address.

2.label: Step 2
2.title: Complete required tasks
2.description: Join our channels, verify actions, and follow instructions on the campaign page.

3.label: Step 3
3.title: Boost with bonus actions
3.description: Share the campaign and invite friends to earn extra entries.

4.label: Step 4
4.title: Verify and submit
4.description: Confirm your participation and keep your wallet connected for prize distribution.

items.1: One primary wallet address per participant. Multiple entries from the same person may be disqualified.
items.2: Winners are selected fairly based on verifiable entries. We reserve the right to re-verify winners.
items.3: Prizes are distributed in LNX on-chain to the connected wallet address only.
items.4: Taxes, reporting, and local regulations are the responsibility of the winners.
items.5: Void where prohibited. We may exclude jurisdictions to comply with local laws.
items.6: Campaign timelines and details may change; updates will be announced on official channels.

Faq.title: FAQs
Faq.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Participation is subject to local laws and regulations. By entering, you agree to the rules above.

winners.question: How are winners selected?
winners.answer: Winners are chosen fairly from validated entries. Additional bonus tasks increase your odds but don't guarantee a win.

announce.question: When will winners be announced?
announce.answer: Final announcement dates will be shared on our official channels. Stay tuned for the timeline update.

paid.question: How are prizes paid?
paid.answer: Prizes are distributed in LNX on-chain directly to the connected wallet address. Ensure you maintain access to it.

wallets.question: Can I use multiple wallets?
wallets.answer: No. Only one primary wallet per participant is allowed. Multiple entries from the same person may be disqualified.
